echo "== healthz =="; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8123/healthz; echo
python3 - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.request

secret = "whsec_smoke"
def make_event(etype):
    return {
        "id": "evt_test_smoke_" + etype,
        "object": "event",
        "type": etype,
        "data": {"object": {
            "id": "pi_smoke",
            "object": "payment_intent",
            "amount": 2000, "currency": "usd",
            "customer": "cus_smoke",
            "metadata": {"order_id": "order_smoke"},
        }},
    }

def post(event):
    body = json.dumps(event).encode()
    ts = str(int(time.time()))
    sig = hmac.new(secret.encode(), f"{ts}.".encode() + body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "http://127.0.0.1:8123/webhook", data=body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Stripe-Signature": f"t={ts},v1={sig}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        print(r.status, r.read().decode())

print("== succeeded ==");   post(make_event("payment_intent.succeeded"))
print("== failed ==");      post(make_event("payment_intent.payment_failed"))
print("== duplicate ==");   post(make_event("payment_intent.succeeded"))
EOF
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/smoke_events.db
echo "--- server log ---"; grep -E "Handled|Ignoring|Rejected" /tmp/uvicorn.log | head
